name: loom-pane
description: A status line naming the session's loom role and the factory members beside it, plus guards that keep an owner inside its own worktree and ask before a removal loses work.

guards.title: Guards
guards.description: Deny an owner's edits outside its own worktree and ask before a branch force-delete or worktree removal that would lose work.

members.title: Members
members.description: List the factory members (this session's agents and the sessions in the repo's worktrees) on the status line, from the engine's agent list and belt's ledger.
